audience: people who assign and follow tasks for their team in Jostle

useCases.title: Check a task and its comments
useCases.text: Get one task with its due date, assignee, collaborators and completion status. Then list the comments on the task.

useCases.title: Find a colleague or a list preset
useCases.text: List the users with their usernames and ids. List the presets to pick a whole group as collaborators.

useCases.title: Create a task for a colleague
useCases.text: Pick the assignee by user id, username or employee id. Add collaborators or a preset if needed. Due dates are saved in Eastern Standard Time.

useCases.title: Change a task's due date or completion
useCases.text: Read the task first. Then change its title, description, due date, assignee, collaborators or completion status.

useCases.title: Post a comment on a task
useCases.text: Add a comment to a task as your user. Everyone who can see the task can read the comment.
